baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine plural participle ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ and the cognate-like manner noun ضَبْحًا couple locomotion to an emitted bodily sound.
baseline_models.mechanism: Extended running drives breath into an audible collective pulse, so the movers are presented from inside their expenditure of force rather than by species or destination.

activation_trace.role: Running and coursing supply the rapid locomotion that generates the line's bodily load.
The panting cry makes otherwise invisible exertion acoustically present.
Running with the forelimbs extended gives the sound a full-stride mechanical source.

changed_reading.before: A generic oath by fast movers.
changed_reading.after: An oath by motion made perceptible as collective, involuntary breath under load.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ can activate branches of ع د و concerned with exceeding a limit and moving across a side or boundary, while ضَبْحًا keeps that crossing embodied.
baseline_models.mechanism: The run is not neutral transit: it presses past a limit, and its rough breath is the audible cost or signature of breaching that threshold.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding a limit turns speed into transgressive passage.
The side or border image supplies the spatial threshold being crossed.
Panting renders the boundary crossing as strenuous and bodily rather than abstract.

changed_reading.after: Forceful passage over a limit, with breath sounding the violence of the crossing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's non-dominant ع و د mapping for ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ supplies return and practiced recurrence, while ضَبْحًا anchors the model in actual strenuous running.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural movers enact a trained circuit: departure already contains return, and repeated exertion turns a single rush into habit, drill, or recurrent sortie.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure bends the apparent one-way run into a circuit.
Habit, training, and persistence make the circuit recurrent and disciplined.
Full-stride running prevents recurrence from becoming a merely abstract temporal notion.

changed_reading.after: A practiced, repeated sortie whose outward force carries an implicit return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping for the plural ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ permits enumeration, prepared array, and recurring time; ضَبْحًا supplies countable breath pulses.
baseline_models.mechanism: Plural bodies become a prepared serial array, and the repeated pant becomes an audible cadence by which expenditure can be counted.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration lets the plural movers register as countable units.
Preparation of equipment turns the units into an array readied for action.
Recurring time supplies cadence rather than a static inventory.
Panting converts the latent count into successive audible beats.

changed_reading.after: A prepared serial array whose expenditure arrives in countable pulses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next line's concealed fire and striking reawaken ض ب ح's burn and ash branches: locomotor effort becomes a mobile ignition train in which contact externalizes stored energy as spark and residue.

activation_trace.role: Coursing supplies the moving energy source.
Burning the upper ends of wood gives the focus sound a dormant combustion edge.
Ash supplies the spent residue of the released energy.
Latent fire emerging from a fire-stick provides stored energy becoming visible.
Striking to kindle fire supplies the contact event that releases the latent energy.

structural_cues: 100:2 preserves the feminine plural participial frame and follows 100:1 with ف, encouraging one continuing mechanism.
The paired adverbial nouns ضَبْحًا and قَدْحًا make breath/impact outputs formally parallel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies running, focus-side burning and ash, concealed fire, and ignition by striking; I supply the arrow from forceful contact to spark and treat breath and char as phases of expenditure. A live alternative is ordinary panting followed by a separate spark-making action.

changed_reading.before: The pant is only an acoustic sign of exertion.
changed_reading.after: The panting run is the first phase of energy conversion, with motion becoming ignition and spent residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Change and dawn turn the focus's boundary crossing into a temporal phase transition: the movers do not merely traverse space but carry a scene across the edge from concealment toward visibility.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding a limit supplies the crossing action.
The side or border branch spatializes the threshold that dawn temporalizes.
Changing a form or replacing one state with another supplies phase transformation.
First daylight supplies the temporal boundary and the arrival of visibility.

structural_cues: 100:3 continues the ف-linked feminine plural sequence.
صُبْحًا occupies the same terminal manner/time slot as the preceding ضَبْحًا and قَدْحًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limit-crossing, alteration, and first daylight; I infer that the continuing movers enact the transition rather than merely being timed by it. The live alternative is a spatial incursion that happens at dawn without causing any phase change.

changed_reading.before: A strenuous crossing of an unspecified boundary.
changed_reading.after: A threshold action that changes the world's phase from hidden night into exposed morning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Motion propagates beyond the movers: it raises and spreads matter, leaves a sign that can be followed, and amplifies bodily sound into an environmental wake of dust and noise.

activation_trace.role: Running supplies the initiating displacement.
Panting begins the wake as a local acoustic emission.
A thing rising and spreading openly expands local force into the surrounding medium.
The non-dominant mapped image of a lasting sign turns disturbance into a readable trace.
Raised dust gives the wake visible material volume.
A raised voice scales the focus pant into a broader field of sound.

structural_cues: The ف sequence makes 100:4 an effect after the preceding motions.
The phrase بِهِ ties the raised medium back to an antecedent action or instrument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies running, panting, rising spread, a lasting mark, dust, and loud sound; I infer that the movers generate one coupled material-acoustic wake. A live alternative restricts نَقْعًا to immediate dust and leaves the lasting-trace branch inactive.

changed_reading.before: Exertion is confined to the runners' bodies.
changed_reading.after: Their passage writes itself into the environment as dust, sound, and a followable after-trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural runners synchronize until their distributed motion behaves like one collected force, then convert that convergence into penetration of a center.

activation_trace.role: Coursing supplies the individual velocity to be coordinated.
Extended full-stride running gives the collected force bodily reach and thrust.
Entering or placing in the middle supplies the penetration target.
Gathering strength or motion until its parts catch up supplies synchronization into one force.

structural_cues: The same feminine plural subject continues through فَوَسَطْنَ.
The alternating action and accusative-output pattern culminates in entering a جَمْع.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiple runners, full-stride extension, entry into a middle, and force whose parts catch up; I infer coordinated convergence causes penetration. A live alternative is simple arrival among an already gathered group without synchronization.

changed_reading.before: Several movers happen to run together.
changed_reading.after: Distributed bodies phase-lock into a collective ram whose convergence enables entry into a center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shift to the visible human, nurturing or covenantal lordship, and severance refunctions the practiced exertion as a relational comparator: sustained embodied response stands beside human refusal of sustaining relation.

activation_trace.role: Habit, training, and persistence supply disciplined repeated response.
Panting makes the cost of that embodied response impossible to idealize away.
The manifest human opposed to wildness identifies the new relational subject.
Nurture, repair, and completion supply the sustaining side of the relation.
Covenant and pledge sharpen nurture into reciprocal obligation.
Cutting and separation supply the human rupture of relation.
Ingratitude names the failed reciprocity that the exertion now measures.

structural_cues: 100:6 breaks the ف-driven action chain with إِنَّ and a new explicit human subject.
The oath scene precedes a lām-intensified relational judgment, inviting but not forcing an analogical contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies practiced expenditure, the visible human, nurture or covenant, and severance or ingratitude; I infer that the oath image functions as a contrastive measure of embodied fidelity. A live alternative reads the movers as a mirror of human predatory violence rather than fidelity.

changed_reading.before: Repeated strenuous motion is a self-contained display of trained force.
changed_reading.after: That costly persistence becomes a relational counter-image to the human who cuts himself from nurture and covenant.

context_deltas.mechanism: Panting becomes indexical testimony: the body emits a sign that proves the force working through it before any verbal witness is introduced.

activation_trace.role: The panting cry is an involuntary bodily datum.
Presence with direct observation supplies the evidentiary stance.
A witnessing mark turns emitted sound into evidence of its hidden cause.

structural_cues: 100:7 repeats the intensified إِنَّهُ ... لَ construction after the moral pivot.
عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ points to an already established condition and makes evidence structurally salient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies panting, direct witnessing, and a sign that testifies; I infer an indexical arrow from sound to hidden exertion. A live alternative confines witness language to the human's awareness of ingratitude and does not project it back onto 100:1.

changed_reading.after: Panting is the body's involuntary witness, making concealed expenditure evidentially audible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attachment to perceived benefit binds the inner subject and recruits outward force; the hard run becomes a psychomotor diagram in which desire tightens into charge.

activation_trace.role: Running supplies desire's outward vector and speed.
Panting measures how completely the motive has recruited the body.
Love adhering to the heart supplies durable inner attachment.
Inclination toward perceived benefit supplies the attractive object.
Tightening a knot converts attraction into binding constraint.
A forceful charge or run reconnects inner binding to the focus's physical acceleration.

structural_cues: 100:8 repeats the intensified pronoun construction and places love, valued good, and severity in one relation.
The focus's active plural motion and ش د د's charge branch permit a body-motive mapping without identifying the subjects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-attachment, attraction to benefit, binding, and a forceful run; I infer that desire acts as propulsion and bodily exertion diagrams motive. A live alternative keeps the oath movers and the later acquisitive human as separate subjects connected only by contrast.

changed_reading.before: The runners' force is externally directed locomotion.
changed_reading.after: Their charge images how attachment to gain tightens inwardly and then spends the body outwardly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's return mapping for ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ is activated by overturned graves and unveiled knowledge: forward surface motion folds into a compelled return whose hidden terminus is opened.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure reverses the apparent one-way vector.
Destination and final return enlarge the circuit from repeated sortie to ultimate terminus.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic result of reversal.
Turning earth and exposing what was buried supplies the vertical reversal.
Concealment and depression supply the hidden terminus that the reversal opens.

structural_cues: إِذَا opens a future condition after the completed rush of the opening sequence.
Passive بُعْثِرَ reverses agency and turns the motion axis from horizontal advance to vertical exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus-side return, a final destination, knowing, overturned earth, and concealment; I infer that the initial outward vector is folded into the later reversal. A live alternative treats 100:9 as a wholly new subject and time with no return-image latent in 100:1.

changed_reading.before: A recurrent sortie that returns to its starting field.
changed_reading.after: An outward rush already shadowed by final return, reversal of the ground, and exposure of what motion seemed to leave behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening pant becomes the exterior layer of an evidentiary assay: bodily output reveals exertion, later extraction reaches the source from which acts issue, and inward knowledge reaches what outward traces only indicate.

activation_trace.role: Panting is the outward symptom from which the assay begins.
Extracting a kernel or precious interior from its covering supplies inward analysis.
The source from which actions issue identifies the hidden causal interior.
Lordly knowledge places the assay within a complete knowing relation.
Knowledge of inward reality completes what external symptoms only begin to disclose.

structural_cues: 100:10 repeats مَا فِي and uses passive حُصِّلَ, shifting attention from surface action to contained interior.
100:11 closes with بِهِمْ and an intensified خَبِيرٌ, converting exposure into comprehensive knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outward breath, extraction from a covering, the inner source of acts, and knowledge of inward reality; I infer one evidentiary continuum from symptom to motive. A live alternative leaves the pant as cinematic sound and treats the later interior disclosure as independent.

changed_reading.before: Breath testifies only to immediate physical effort.
changed_reading.after: Breath is the first exterior symptom in a trace that ultimately exposes the inward source of action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins rare burn, blackening, ash, dust, and barren-land branches into an ecological consequence model. It remains anchored in ضَبْحًا's own combustion residues and the focus's forceful passage, with explicit later material activators; downstream prose should call it a cross-domain activation, not a lexical gloss or a claim that the ayah directly names environmental degradation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ضَبْحًا carries accepted branches of burning, blackening, and ash, while ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ supplies the accelerating passage that can distribute disturbance.

activation_trace.role: Burning upper wood supplies localized scorching inside the focus inventory.
Blackening supplies a visible transformation caused by spent heat.
Ash supplies residual matter after combustion.
Latent fire becoming external activates the focus's dormant scorching sequence.
Raised dust carries the disturbance from contact point into atmosphere.
Land that does not grow supplies a possible endpoint of repeated scorching and particulate disturbance.

changed_reading.before: Acceleration spends energy only in breath and speed.
changed_reading.after: Acceleration becomes a disturbance ecology that externalizes heat, dark residue, dust, and possible infertility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping rather than the ordinary running branch. It remains formally anchored in the plural focus word and its audible cadence, and later gathering/outcome branches make accumulation functional; downstream prose should present it as a counted-motion resonance, not as a replacement translation of ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ has an explicit split mapping to enumeration and recurring count, while ضَبْحًا can segment the run into audible units.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration makes each mover or exertion pulse an entry.
Recurring time turns separate entries into an accumulating cadence.
Panting makes the cadence sensorially countable.
Gathering dispersed things into one total supplies accumulation.
Collecting until the outcome appears converts accumulated pulses into a final resultant.

changed_reading.before: The runners form a vivid but unmeasured rush.
changed_reading.after: Each expenditure becomes a counted entry accumulating toward a disclosed total.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples the focus's disease-transmission branch with lung or inward illness and later heart-attachment. It remains anchored in ٱلْعَادِيَاتِ as a moving vector and ضَبْحًا as breath, while the desire cues supply what spreads; downstream prose should mark it as a pathological analogy for appetite, not an assertion of literal infection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory links ع د و to transmission of disease and ض ب ح to breath, allowing the moving plural to be tested as a vector rather than only as runners.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of disease changes movement from transit into propagation.
Breath gives the propagation model a bodily carrier and symptom.
Disease consuming the interior or lung activates a pathological reading of the pant.
Love adhering to the heart supplies the inward appetite that can propagate.
Inclination toward perceived benefit supplies the appetite's transmissible orientation.

changed_reading.after: Breath-bearing motion images acquisitive appetite as an inward-consuming condition that propagates through vectors.

strongest_changes: ضَبْحًا shifts from sound effect to the first phase of an ignition-and-residue mechanism.
Plural running becomes a coupled environmental wake and then a synchronized penetrating force.
Panting becomes involuntary testimony and the exterior symptom of an assay that reaches inward motive.
The apparent one-way rush folds into return, ground reversal, and disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories already hide combustion, transgression, count, contagion, and return beside ordinary running and panting. Later sparks, dawn, dust, gathering, ingratitude, witness, desire, overturning, extraction, and inward knowledge selectively awaken those branches without collapsing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Dawn may merely time the movement rather than make it a causal phase transition.
The relational analogy may contrast disciplined expenditure with ingratitude, or instead mirror human predatory force.
Count, return, ecological residue, and contagious appetite depend on non-dominant or branch-distant activations and should remain resonances rather than replacement glosses.
